entries.what: Bluecoast Consulting Engineers (2020) Albany Artificial Surf Reef - Detailed Design Report P19024_DetailedDesign_R2.00 (cross-sections, 2017 bathymetry, coordinates)
entries.where: https://albany.wa.gov.au/documents/801/albany-artificial-surf-reef-executive-summary-detailed-design ; City of Albany SOSR project pages
entries.detail: Only the executive summary is public; the full Detailed Design Report (cross-sections, 2017 bathymetry, footprint coordinates, vertical datum) is not on the City site. The design table/plan (design.jpg) and project profile give crest -1.00 m AHD, 34,000 m3 and a plan outline (these are references) but no seabed levels, pile height, side slopes or toe level, which is what blocks the 3D model. A search for a post-construction (as-built) survey also found nothing.
entries.might_work: Lior: E9 (e-mail the City of Albany project team) / P12; search `"P19024" Bluecoast Albany detailed design report`

entries.what: EMODnet Bathymetry DTM 2024 (viewer, REST, ERDDAP) for seabed depth at the reef
entries.where: https://emodnet.ec.europa.eu/geoviewer/ ; EMODnet Bathymetry REST depth_sample / ERDDAP bathymetry_dtm_2024 at -35.0236, 117.9136
entries.detail: EMODnet covers European seas only; the REST service returns HTTP 204 (empty) at this reef's coordinate (Australia), so the site is outside the grid. Only two of the 13 reefs are covered (Boscombe, Borth). Do not retry EMODnet for this reef.
entries.might_work: Local sources instead: national or state bathymetry, a council or authority survey, Navionics / Google Earth readings (see REQUESTS_FOR_LIOR.md section 5)

entries.what: Raised Water Research Albany gallery images: granite quarry stockpiles, vessel-track map, surf photos and construction barge (registry img-08 and img-09 and others)
entries.by: agent: Albany shape agent (queue item 9, cloud)
entries.detail: The quarry photo shows only the rock source, the vessel-track map (AIS tracks of P.T. MONTO between Port Albany and Middleton Beach) only the rock-carrying route, and the surf photos (01, 02, 04, 07) and barge photo (06) carry no plan information; they were registered with display false or as context and not used for geometry. The two construction overviews (May 2025, ABC 'Supplied' vessels photo) are oblique with no scale and partly built, so not traced. The usable plan sources are the Bluecoast design plan (via RWR) and the City design table.

entries.what: Seabed levels at the Albany reef: the City's 2017 bathymetry, and a datum for the 2015 Royal HaskoningDHV Option B contour plot
entries.where: City of Albany documents (executive summary of the Detailed Design Report 2020, FAQs 2023, project profile 2024, 2015 feasibility summary, project page); RWR copy of the RHDHV 2015 Option B plan; BMT (2018) EIA Fig 6.9
entries.by: agent: Albany 3D agent (cloud, network Full); compiled from its METHODS_3D.md
entries.detail: The 2017 City bathymetry (on which the 34,000 m3 volume is 'based') is not published, and none of the fetched City documents gives a seabed depth. The seabed therefore uses a 2015 design contour plot of unstated datum (georeferenced by hand, +-5 m) and the BMT 2018 spot soundings in m CD, which conflict: the 2.7 m CD sounding near the shore is 1.6 m (CD = AHD) or 2.3 m (CD = LAT) deeper than the profile, unresolved. 3D confidence is LOW; pile height and side slopes are not sourced.
entries.might_work: Lior: E9 (Bluecoast Detailed Design Report P19024 with the 2017 bathymetry, and the March 2025 as-built survey)
